description: Your coin's mode from its next round (the round filling keeps its own): full (its rounds draw its prize), draws (each round pays drawSol in SOL to its winner), prizes (you give prizes from its pot with award_prize; only a coin nobody but you holds can switch to it, has_holders otherwise) or redeem (no draws: the pot pays for redemptions, and a holder burns enough coins for its one prize, a store item or a gift card; only a coin nobody but you holds can switch to it, and it stays one once others hold it). Into redeem or out of it: has_holders while anyone but you holds the coin, and redeeming while a redemption is on its way (a burn prepared in the last 15 minutes, or one found and not settled); into redeem also rounds_open while a round of the coin is unfinished. Answers the coin, as get_coin does. Takes a coin key from create_coin_key as coinKey or as the request's Authorization: Bearer ck_live_… header; it works for every coin its wallet created. Refused with "The coin API's keys and writes are not open yet." only if Souvenir pauses the coin API.

coinKey.description: Your coin key (ck_live_…, from create_coin_key). Not needed when the request sends it as Authorization: Bearer ck_live_….

drawSol.description: draws: the SOL each round pays, 0.1 to 100, as a decimal string ("0.5").

name: set_coin_mode
title: Set your coin's mode
